anchor.label: Catch-up: last swipe test, hero card lag, GPU lesson #7

messages.text:
You could not direct message to worker agents who have the own work to do. 

They can reply is ok, for the questions. there might be take long time to answer cause they busy.

Understood: I won't message a busy worker agent for your questions; it can reply later.

- Your T-098 question already goes to a free code-reading helper, not to fix-hero-exit-threaded; the answer comes there.
- A busy owner sees the thread when its own step ends and may add to the answer then; a slow reply is fine.
- I still message workers about their own work (your decision on their proposal, queue order, landing).
- Saved as a standing rule for every agent (memory note "busy workers answer later").

What you need to do: nothing.
Do we need to find the long-term for fix this how to handle the message ?

Yes, and I've started it: a router change so a user question never wakes a busy agent.

- Today the router (the part that picks who gets your thread message) sends it to the topic's owner, even mid-work.
- The fix (incident I-164): when the owner is busy (in a test, a build or holding the phone), your message goes to the lead or the desk. They answer now, or send a code-reading helper.
- The busy owner gets it as a note it sees when its step ends, and may add to the answer then.
- Your decisions on an owner's own proposal still reach it right away.
- Same change fixes I-163 (the desk's old listener that held up T-146). ts-board (the board toolsmith) builds it after its current fix, with tests. Until then I route by hand; I'm the desk.

What you need to do: nothing.
